name: SurveyTemplates
description: Adds the default survey templates offered when a survey is created.
author: CrestApps

Templates.Name: customer-satisfaction
Templates.Title: Customer satisfaction
Templates.Description: Measure how satisfied customers are with a CSAT question and follow-ups.

Questions.Name: q1
Questions.Title: How satisfied are you with our service?

Questions.Name: q2
Questions.Title: How likely are you to use our service again?

Templates.Name: nps
Templates.Title: Net Promoter Score
Templates.Description: Ask how likely people are to recommend you, and why.

Questions.Name: q1
Questions.Title: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend or colleague?

Questions.Name: q2
Questions.Title: What is the main reason for your score?

Templates.Name: employee-engagement
Templates.Title: Employee engagement
Templates.Description: A grid of agreement statements about work and the team.

Questions.Name: q1
Questions.Title: How much do you agree with each statement?

Rows.Name: proud
Rows.Text: I am proud to work here.

Rows.Name: growth
Rows.Text: I have opportunities to learn and grow.

Rows.Name: recognition
Rows.Text: I receive recognition for good work.

Questions.Name: q2
Questions.Title: What one change would make this a better place to work?

Templates.Name: event-feedback
Templates.Title: Event feedback
Templates.Description: Rate an event and say what to keep and change.

Questions.Name: q1
Questions.Title: How would you rate the event overall?

Questions.Name: q3
Questions.Title: What should we change next time?

Templates.Name: quiz
Templates.Title: Quiz
Templates.Description: A scored quiz with a pass mark and right answers.

Questions.Name: q1
Questions.Title: Which planet is known as the red planet?

Questions.Name: q2
Questions.Title: Which of these are prime numbers?

Templates.Name: poll
Templates.Title: Poll
Templates.Description: One question whose totals respondents see after they answer.

Questions.Name: q1
Questions.Title: What should we work on next?
